stem: Wilted plants occur in wet media, and no pest or pathogen sign has been confirmed. Which diagnostic approach is strongest?
choices: Keep root dysfunction, irrigation, environment and disease in the differential and collect evidence that separates them.
Apply a pesticide immediately because wilt can be caused by disease.
Irrigate more because wilt always indicates water shortage.
Rule out disease because media are wet.
rationale: Wilt has multiple biotic and abiotic causes; wet media can be consistent with root dysfunction and does not confirm or exclude disease.
